Strip Dumplings purchase + new Undo Unlock IAP. BuyCoinsModal now early-returns null at the top so every mount site no-ops without per-site edits; the Buy Dumplings modal is fully retired. Header + GameplayChrome coin pills are display-only on web (no onClick, no '+' affordance) and stay hidden on iOS via IS_IOS_BUILD as before. Users still earn Dumplings through gameplay; the purchase flow is gone. New users.unlockedUndo boolean. functions/index.js: undoLast now rejects out-of-grace placements ('Undo only available during the 4-second grace window') and rejects in-grace placements without unlockedUndo ('Undo Unlock not purchased'). Dropped the legacy Dumpling cost branch and the FieldValue.increment(-1) charge. New exports.purchaseUndoUnlock callable accepts an opaque receipt + platform string, flips users.unlockedUndo=true, stores receipt + platform + timestamp for later StoreKit / Stripe verification. Client undo handler: outside grace -> toast; inside grace + locked -> opens UndoUnlockModal; inside grace + unlocked -> fires undoLast. New UndoUnlockModal: bash.99 one-time per-user, gold CTA button + Not Now. Top-level state syncs unlockedUndo from users/{pid} via existing snapshot + visibility-resync listeners. Fix screenname clobber on sign-in + unblock rename when setScreenname callable isn't deployed. signInGoogle + signInApple now (a) read users/{uid} BEFORE writing - if an existing screenname is present, keep it instead of overwriting with the provider display name, and (b) use setDoc with merge:true so a brand-new uid actually creates the doc (updateDoc silently no-oped on missing docs, leaving the auto-screenname useEffect to win the race and assign an AdjNoun42 generic name). Settings saveName: if the setScreenname callable returns a non-validation error (e.g. function not yet deployed, transient internal), fall back to a direct updateDoc with name + nameLower + lastScreennameChange so the user can still rename. Validation errors (already-exists, rate limit, invalid-argument) still surface their server message and skip the fallback.

v0.14.44 Pineapple casual round-advance delay fix. App.js L8879: before setting the 4s lockGrace undo window, check whether every other seated player already has placedThisRound=true. If yes - you are the last to finish placing - skip the grace and commit placedThisRound=true immediately via the same updateDoc path competitive uses. If at least one opponent is still placing, keep the 4s grace as today so you can still undo while they think. Net effect: in casual, when you are the second-to-finish you still get your 4s window; when you are the last to finish the round advances instantly instead of forcing the whole table to wait for an undo you cannot use anyway. No server changes.

v0.14.41 Fix Palace summary rendering literal '\u00b7' instead of middle dot. JSX text content doesn't process backslash escape sequences (only JS string literals do), so all 5 spots in PalaceFinishedView + PalaceWinningCardHold that used \u00b7 / \u2026 as bare JSX text were rendering as the raw 6-char sequence ('1ST \u00b7 NAME', 'palace conquered \u00b7 won by', etc.). Replaced with literal middle-dot + ellipsis characters. Only fixed JSX-text positions; the same escapes inside template literals (${} \u00b7) already worked correctly because those evaluate as JS strings.

v0.14.40 Palace stats — multiplayer archive was reading game.players[pid].finishOrder which doesn't exist on the player doc. Server writes finishPlace (1-indexed; set when the player empties their stacks). myFin was always undefined, firstPlace always false, and every multiplayer match recorded as a loss. Swap to finishPlace and check === 1. Bot games still don't archive at all - separate follow-up. No server changes.

v0.14.39 Fix update banner not firing on iOS PWA. src/index.js — after every reg.update() resolve, re-poll reg.waiting and dispatch sw-update-available if a waiting worker exists. Previously only the initial registration call checked reg.waiting; the 30s setInterval + visibilitychange + focus refreshes only relied on updatefound, which iOS WebKit sometimes skips when updates happen in the background. With this change, the explicit reg.waiting poll runs on every refresh path so even when updatefound doesn't fire, the banner still latches on the next 30s tick.

Canonical Palace deals face-down blindly first, so the player has no control over which 3 are buried. Server: togglePalaceReady now deals 3 to faceDown + 6 to setupChoices per player (deck.splice(0,3) then deck.splice(0,6)). palaceChooseTopCards: leftover 3 from setupChoices goes directly to hand; second deal-from-deck step removed since hand is now derived. Bot transitionToSetup + applySetup mirror. PalaceSetupView UI unchanged - player still picks 3 of 6 visible cards, blind face-down stack is silently dealt. Total cards per player remains 9 (3 fd + 3 fu + 3 hand). Needs firebase deploy --only functions.

v0.14.31 Rematch: delete old game doc after rematch lobby is created so it stops showing up in Active Games. startRematch (App.js ~L10360) creates the new doc + writes nextGameId on the old doc + setGameId(newId), then schedules a deleteDoc(old) 2.5s later. The 2.5s window covers the opponent's listener round-trip and joinGameById call so their bounce-out-on-delete handler doesn't fire before they've already switched to the new gameId via the auto-route useEffect (L7159). Only the host issues the delete; opponent's join is idempotent and not coupled to cleanup. Firestore games update+delete rules both allow it (host is in resource.data.order). Fix: previously both old matchOver doc and new lobby doc lived side-by-side in the Active Games listener (where('order', 'array-contains', pid)), showing as duplicate.
